leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest DVD sets were released in 2016 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Set 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Set 1 was released on July 12, 2016. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined.

 

===Set 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Set 2 was released on December 13, 2016. It contains three discs with 23 episodes across them combined.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon The Series: XY Kalos Quest - The Complete Season was released by with distribution through on September 24, 2024. This Complete Collection set contains 6 DVD discs with forty-five episodes altogether, in a with stereo audio and optional English SDH subtitles.
